scope.description: Implement and independently validate the deterministic C++17 joint-signature and global-FDR P4 science kernel: top-partner selection, complete-core-read categorical association, stratified 999-permutation evidence, same-readset per-marker effect gates, global BH/BY correction and explicit fail-closed statuses. Python is limited to synthetic/small oracle generation and never executes in production.

assumptions: The pinned historical authority is InterSubMod/research/20260715_all_ssnv_focal_alt_multigroup_cooccurrence_validation/scripts/analyze_methyl_ssnv_cooccurrence.py at SHA-256 3d7650983fce68abc122748d167e56b9a53bc6ef9775b9b1beb19793e25a769c.
The implementation is an independent C++17 reimplementation against bounded synthetic vectors; existing co-occurrence files, CMake and production orchestration remain untouched.
Stable keys, deterministic PCG64 permutation order, exact status precedence and canonical global correction order are required; malformed, incomplete or unsupported inputs fail closed.
Any historical behavior that depends on unordered Python containers or implicit row order must be made explicit and tested rather than copied as platform accident.
The receipt is synthetic/small scientific evidence only and cannot promote an HCC1395 or seven-dataset production claim.

step_verify.step: Extract and record exact historical top-partner, joint-signature, permutation, same-readset effect-gate and global-FDR semantics.
step_verify.verify: Every ported rule is mapped to a pinned source line or an explicit documented deviation; no broad repository search or production Python execution occurs.

step_verify.step: Implement deterministic C++17 joint-signature and global-FDR APIs with fail-closed status precedence.
step_verify.verify: Strict standalone Debug and Release compilation passes with -Werror, -fno-fast-math and -ffp-contract=off; production code contains no Python process invocation.

step_verify.step: Replay positive, null, tie, missing, strata, same-readset and global BH/BY edge vectors.
step_verify.verify: Pinned statuses, selected partners, effects, permutation p-values, adjusted q-values and semantic digests match; stable-key input order and worker-independent calls are invariant.

step_verify.step: Obtain independent parent replay and freeze a receipt.
step_verify.verify: Independent exit 0 and exact output are recorded with receipt and binary SHA-256 before task release/archive.

evidence.command: strict GCC Debug/Release/ASan+UBSan compile and replay; independent parent Release replay; independent P4/P5 complete-readset digest cross-replay

deviations: The signed-v5 authority pins analyzer SHA-256 3d7650983fce68abc122748d167e56b9a53bc6ef9775b9b1beb19793e25a769c at 208031 bytes; the live analyzer is 6dc673fafaeeb7e0c0c8335915a0b8ea1a9b14c9344132e1640a93f96c7ac4f0 at 210257 bytes. Per parent authorization, the signed-v5 manifest plus byte-identical science library 3d41023b03f1f047312011f8513b685bf7ffe25f5d0795d253bc9013b9ec88ff are authoritative; the live analyzer is only a function-location reference.
Read and stratum ordering are explicit deterministic stable-key/lexicographic orders rather than incidental Python input/container order; Python oracle rows were aligned to the same order.
Malformed finite/non-finite/off-grid permutation p-values fail closed as INVALID_JOINT_SIGNATURE_PERMUTATION_EVIDENCE instead of inheriting ambiguous historical BH behavior.

The LongLineage post-global finalizer explicitly sets global calibration and topology PASS fields; the historical per-site pre-global helper left postselection_fdr_calibrated false and a later reconciliation function applied the formal candidate gate.

The repository publication repair later replaced private absolute-path strings in the receipt with portable tokens. The input and evidence SHA values now bind that sanitized projection; joint-signature counts and verdict fields were not changed.
